summary: The gpt camp is out here flexing at 139k like they actually did something besides phone it in, while everyone else is eating dust. The claude camp absolutely embarrassed itself at the bottom with 53k after getting laughed out of the building for running a deprecated model that got a straight 404 rejection. Deepseek clawed past the headline_arena and qwen camps, but the gemini camp looked completely lost, repeatedly trying to sell zero percent of things and shoving tickers that aren't even in the universe.
